describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): ratify orthogonal identities and the exact-release law (#802)

rule: Each case states its input, the required outcome and the forbidden outcome, the catalog rules it exercises (CR..), existing evidence at this head, and the node whose test makes it executable. CAT0 ships no test. 'Today' describes the described head; a required outcome that differs from today names the owner allowed to change it. Surfaces: registry, session, LSP, MCP, NAPI, WASM, client.

registrationMatrix.name: default static registration is fact- and byte-equivalent
registrationMatrix.input: A host built with default framework options (every composed vertical)

required.registry: Vue and Svelte semantic-profile rows; wire tag VUE and SVELTE resolve to them, REACT and SOLID are out of scope, NONE and OPEN_CANONICAL have no disposition
required.session: .vue classifies as the Vue component carrier, .svelte as the Svelte component carrier, .svelte.ts and .svelte.js as Svelte adapter modules (non-component), the TS/JS rows as plain scripts, an unknown extension as plain script routing; the Vue grammar fingerprint keeps its v1 golden encoding
required.LSP: carrier watch globs and file-operation filters cover exactly the .vue and .svelte carrier extensions
required.MCP: component tools serve .vue and .svelte files through the same host catalog
required.NAPI: default admission admits every composed vertical
required.WASM: default admission admits every composed vertical
required.client: client-framework-manifest.generated.ts and virtual-file-naming.generated.ts are byte-equal to the committed files

registrationMatrix.forbidden: Any observable difference from the described head on these surfaces; a surface building its own registry instead of reading the snapshot

registrationMatrix.name: narrowed admission does not shrink the catalog
registrationMatrix.input: A host built with admission narrowed to vue (the LSP --frameworks=vue flag, or NAPI/WASM admitting ['vue'])

required.registry: the CatalogSnapshot and its identity equal RM01's
required.session: as today, .svelte falls through to plain-script routing, .svelte.ts and .svelte.js classify as plain scripts, no Svelte grammar is active and no Svelte script-fact provider runs; the withdrawal comes from the DemandPlan, not from a smaller catalog
required.LSP: as today, the watch globs and file-operation filters are derived from the same classification and cover .vue only
required.MCP: not applicable: the MCP server exposes no admission option at this head
required.client: generated mirrors are unchanged (they are rendered from the snapshot, never from admission)

registrationMatrix.forbidden: A second, narrowed catalog; a snapshot identity that depends on admission; a Svelte row that is registered and still silently served
registrationMatrix.note: Today a framework-surface request naming svelte on a Vue-only host is a typed MalformedPayload (unknown adapter id). CPF1 keeps that response at its cutover; changing the response of a registered but non-participating profile belongs to COX0 under COX0-AC1, never to the catalog shape.

registrationMatrix.name: invalid admission is rejected without touching the catalog
registrationMatrix.input: Admission naming an unregistered family ('react'), a duplicate ('vue', 'vue'), or nothing
registrationMatrix.required: Each is a typed rejection naming the supported set, as today; the catalog is built the same way regardless
registrationMatrix.forbidden: Silently admitting everything; an unknown name creating or removing a row

registrationMatrix.name: two carrier rows share one editor language id
registrationMatrix.input: Row providers registering two carrier rows with the same carrier language id
registrationMatrix.required: Snapshot construction fails with a typed error naming both rows
registrationMatrix.forbidden: Last-wins or first-wins registration; construction that succeeds and dispatches one of them

registrationMatrix.name: two carrier rows claim one extension at the same precedence
registrationMatrix.input: Two carrier rows both claiming .vue; separately, a row claiming .svelte.ts beside the plain .ts row
registrationMatrix.required: The first fails construction naming both owners; the second is legal because the longer suffix has the higher precedence
registrationMatrix.forbidden: Classification decided by provider order; rejecting a legal longer-suffix claim

registrationMatrix.name: duplicate semantic-profile key versus shared display family
registrationMatrix.input: Two semantic-profile rows with the same FrameworkProfileId; separately, two rows with the same display family and different exact releases (the Vue 2.6 and Vue 3 fixture values of VID0 VC02)
registrationMatrix.required: The first fails construction naming both owners; the second registers two rows with two identities
registrationMatrix.forbidden: A display family used as the row key; one row silently shadowing the other

registrationMatrix.name: dangling references fail construction
registrationMatrix.input: A semantic-profile row claiming a carrier with no carrier row; a backend row for an unknown carrier; a carrier row with no grammar; a project-profile row overlaying an unknown semantic profile
registrationMatrix.required: Each fails construction with a typed error naming the missing id
registrationMatrix.forbidden: A partially built snapshot; a row dropped with a warning
registrationMatrix.note: The project-profile leg becomes executable when T04 exists; PPR0T adds it under PPR0T-AC1.

registrationMatrix.name: a carrier with no compiler backend
registrationMatrix.input: A carrier row with a frontend and no backend row (the HTML/Astro type-level frontend stubs)
registrationMatrix.required: The snapshot builds; tooling surfaces read the carrier; compilation reports not applicable for that carrier
registrationMatrix.forbidden: An Unsupported compiler implementation registered to fill the slot; a construction error for the missing backend

registrationMatrix.name: dormant family row is a data-only change
registrationMatrix.input: A test composition root that adds one inert family through the public row-provider path: one carrier row with a test-only extension, one semantic-profile row, no backend, no participation, and the regenerated mirrors
registrationMatrix.required: No neutral routing source changes (no new match arm, branch or switch); every RM01 Vue and Svelte outcome is unchanged; the snapshot identity differs from RM01; each generated mirror differs from RM01 only by the dormant entry; the dormant profile does zero work on .vue and .svelte files
registrationMatrix.forbidden: Any edit to shared dispatch code to admit the row; a test-only constructor that bypasses snapshot validation

registrationMatrix.name: profile-qualified capability rows
registrationMatrix.input: One capability key registered under two profiles; a gated language row with its capability bit off and then on
registrationMatrix.required: Two distinct capability identities; the gated row resolves to its candidate only while the bit is on
registrationMatrix.forbidden: One untagged capability shared across profiles; a process-wide gate

registrationMatrix.name: conflicting external contributions
registrationMatrix.input: Two data-manifest contributions claiming the same (kind, namespace, key) with different versions, admitted in both orders; one contribution claiming the FrameworkProfileId of an official-static row
registrationMatrix.required: A deterministic typed conflict, identical for both admission orders; the claim on an official row is rejected
registrationMatrix.forbidden: First-loaded or fastest-returning wins; an official row replaced by a contribution

registrationMatrix.name: a contribution cannot replace a core authority
registrationMatrix.input: A contribution declaring a replacement parser for a registered carrier, a replacement type resolver, or a cache-validity rule
registrationMatrix.required: Admission rejects it with a typed error
registrationMatrix.forbidden: Any contribution changing parse, identity, type semantics, resolution, cache validity or edit-transaction authority

determinismCases.name: provider order and hash seeds do not matter
determinismCases.input: The RM01 rows provided Vue-first and Svelte-first, each under two hasher seeds
determinismCases.required: Equal snapshot identity, equal table order and byte-equal generated mirrors in all four builds
determinismCases.forbidden: Table order or identity following provider order or map iteration
determinismCases.note: verter_session framework::registry::tests::composed_rows_keep_the_frontend_catalog_order pins today's static provider order; CPF1 replaces it with this case (CAT-F02).

determinismCases.name: identity is stable across constructions and processes
determinismCases.input: The same rows built twice in one process and once in another process
determinismCases.required: Equal snapshot identity and equal canonical encoding bytes
determinismCases.forbidden: An identity that includes an address, a counter, a timestamp or a process id

determinismCases.name: identity excludes what is not registration
determinismCases.input: RM01 rows built under different admission options, different workspaces and different type-engine bindings
determinismCases.forbidden: Admission, workspace, project, revision or backend identity in the snapshot key

determinismCases.name: identity moves with every semantic change
determinismCases.input: RM01 rows, then: one row added; one descriptor column changed (a virtual-file suffix); the ProfileSchemaEpoch bumped; one exact release changed
determinismCases.required: Each change yields a different snapshot identity
determinismCases.forbidden: A semantic row change that leaves the identity equal
determinismCases.note: The release-change leg is VID0 VC11's catalog half (CPF1-AC2).

determinismCases.name: presentation order is not identity
determinismCases.input: RM01 rows with the Vue and Svelte presentation ranks swapped
determinismCases.required: Generated mirrors list Svelte before Vue; snapshot identity and dispatch are unchanged
determinismCases.forbidden: Presentation rank entering the snapshot identity or any dispatch decision

manifestBytePinning.name: mirrors regenerate byte-equal from the snapshot
manifestBytePinning.input: The RM01 snapshot rendered by the two generators
manifestBytePinning.required: Bytes equal to the committed client-framework-manifest.generated.ts and virtual-file-naming.generated.ts
manifestBytePinning.forbidden: A generator reading descriptor.rs or the extension table directly after the cutover; two sources for one mirror

manifestBytePinning.name: a hand edit fails freshness
manifestBytePinning.input: One byte of a committed mirror edited by hand
manifestBytePinning.forbidden: A freshness check that regenerates and passes without comparing

manifestBytePinning.name: per-family split keeps the index bytes
manifestBytePinning.input: The mirrors split into one generated file per family behind the two index files
manifestBytePinning.required: Consumers of the two index files see unchanged Vue and Svelte bytes
manifestBytePinning.forbidden: A family file written by hand; an index that lists families by a hard-coded name list
